purpose: Teach: 手のひら/アクセント/モーニング/出来上がり/隣人/いわく/たかが/まかせ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の手のひらに小さなクッキー、お渡しできるかな、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, could you hand the customer a small cookie right in their palm?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with quiet certainty underneath. Soft opening, almost a question but grounded. Deliberate pace. Trailing upward lilt suggests she's checking Aoi's readiness, not doubting her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、関西アクセントのお客様、いらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we have a customer who speaks with a Kansai accent — they just came in.
lines.style: Bright, quick-paced delivery with delight in the observation. Open-throated, energetic. Light emphasis on the novelty. No hesitation — sharing something that caught her attention and made her smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、モーニングセット、人気よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the morning set really is popular, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm appreciation with a note of satisfaction. Steady, conversational tempo. Slight rise at the end — inviting Aoi to notice what she's already seeing. Pride in the shared success of the cafe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新作ケーキの出来上がり、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, look how beautifully the new cake came together.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, spoken softly. Eyes-up quality — like she's stepped back to really see the work. Unhurried, reverent almost. A small moment of recognizing craft.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、隣人さんへのご挨拶、欠かさないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't forget to greet the neighbors — it matters.
lines.style: Gentle but firm guidance with care woven through. Quiet emphasis on 'matters,' not harsh. The tone of someone who knows something from experience and wants Aoi to have it too. Almost protective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、コーヒー通いわく、温度が大事って、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a regular coffee drinker was just saying temperature is really what makes the difference.
lines.style: Conversational, passing along something worth knowing. Reflective pause before 'temperature' — letting the idea land. Not lecturing, just sharing a small truth she overheard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、たかがコーヒーって思わないで、丁寧に淹れようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't think of it as 'just coffee' — let's brew it with care, the way it deserves.
lines.style: Quiet insistence with tenderness. Slow, deliberate delivery of 'just coffee' — she's undoing that thought in real time. Then softens into invitation with 'the way it deserves.' Almost intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんに調理をまかせる時期だよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I think it's time to trust the new person with some of the cooking.
lines.style: Reflective and observant, a small recognizing exhale. Measured pace. Soft conviction — she's been watching and knows Aoi is ready to let go a little. Encouraging without being prompt.
